workflows.name: linkedin-content
workflows.generate: Draft two LinkedIn posts for the upcoming Saturday slot: one founder-voice post for Navid's personal page, and one Subturtle-voice post for the Subturtle company page. Follow the playbook's founder-post rules for tone on the founder post, and use a company voice (still first-person-plural or product-voice, same plain IELTS-6 English, same no-hashtag-soup/no-fake-metrics rules) for the Subturtle post. Read the last ~10 published/drafted posts for each voice first and skip overlap. Create both as separate tasks tagged per the rules below.

workflows.name: reddit-content
workflows.generate: Scan the 6 non-Korean subs (languagelearning, EnglishLearning, LearnJapanese, Spanish, French, German) once a day. Check each sub's current self-promo/AI rules first. Draft 0-2 comment tasks total, only on threads where existing comments genuinely miss an angle Subturtle's approach would add - never force a draft to hit a quota. Skip duplicates of pending drafts, already-well-covered threads, locked threads, or threads whose rules argue against the angle.
